guides.title: Professions on Turtle WoW 1.18.1
guides.intro: **Recommendation:** on almost every class, level with **two gathering professions** for gold. At 60, drop one and take **Engineering**, which is the only profession that directly adds raid damage or threat (Goblin Sapper Charges, grenades, Battle Chicken, Force Reactive Disk). Keep **Herbalism** if you farm the Dire Maul East lashers, or **Mining** if you farm Zul'Gurub. Take a crafting profession only for a specific BoP item your spec needs, and buy BoE crafts instead of leveling a profession for them. Add **Survival**, the reworked secondary profession, for the slingshot ranged pull, ammo and gathering tools. Class pages: [Druid](#/class/druid/professions) · [Hunter](#/class/hunter/professions) · [Mage](#/class/mage/professions) · [Paladin](#/class/paladin/professions) · [Priest](#/class/priest/professions) · [Rogue](#/class/rogue/professions) · [Shaman](#/class/shaman/professions) · [Warlock](#/class/warlock/professions) · [Warrior](#/class/warrior/professions). Turtle keeps the vanilla primary professions and adds one new primary profession, **Jewelcrafting** (1.17.2). It also has two custom secondary professions: **Survival**, fully reworked in 1.18.1, and **Gardening**, which needs Survival. On top of that are custom recipes for the vanilla professions and, in 1.18.1, an experimental **crafted-item upgrade** system. Gnomish and Goblin Engineering are "basically the same" as vanilla, apart from new recipes Selenya <WotF> / Flykra <WSC> · 2025-07-20. Profession content is called "kinda neglected on this server" Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-30.

sections.heading: Primary professions
sections.markdown: ### Engineering - **What it gives:** Goblin Sapper Charges (off the GCD Pepopo · 2026-04-14), grenades and dynamite, Battle Chicken, target dummies, the Force Reactive Disk (paladin farming and AoE tanking Silverhand · 2026-04-01), teleporters to Stormwind, Orgrimmar and Everlook Mithreon · 2026-01-14, and parachute cloaks. - **Turtle-specific:** - Battle Chicken no longer procs on demand. It starts a random 30-80 s timer in combat 30 · 2025-10-18. - The **Facetted Crystal Scope** (+2% ranged crit; schematic from the Draenei Exiles at Revered) Itron · 2026-03-20, yaboikeenser · 2026-03-21. - **Enchanted Thorium Shells** (1.18.1 ammo). Staff name Cannon Master Willey as the schematic source ([Torta (staff), 2026-04-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174367#p174367)), but players still report it not dropping ([Roegnvald (player), 2026-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175240#p175240)). **Contested.** - **Caster goggles** in 1.18.1, upgraded with an item from a BWL boss, with a large spell-power proc Ydr · 2026-03-25, Memesh · 2026-03-21. - Jewelcrafting's tools (Jewelry Lens at 125, Precision Jewelers Kit at 175, Jewelry Scope at 225) are Engineering crafts ([Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106310#p106310)). - **Gnomish vs Goblin:** take Gnomish first and make the BoP items you can't buy ("death ray and battle chicken"), then swap Agitation / Jinxi · 2025-07-04, Agitation / Jinxi · 2025-07-04. Relearn as Goblin to craft your own Sappers and rocket boots roguecraft · 2026-03-30. Switching specialisation means leveling Engineering again from 1 eric4225 · 2026-03-10, eric4225 · 2026-03-10. - **Druids:** Sappers and grenades don't work in Cat or Bear Form. Moonkin can use Sappers in form Treehide/Verrik · 2025-10-08. Which other Engineering items work in form is **contested** (see the druid page). - **Cost:** about 100-150g from 1 to 300 gastro · 2026-04-04. Engineering makes no gold malorak · 2025-01-29. ### Alchemy (+ Herbalism) - Makes potions, elixirs and flasks, the raid buffs everyone needs thebigclamp · 2025-08-14. Herbalism + Alchemy is the usual "first character" and gold pair Gees · 2025-12-18, and "def not alchemy without herba" Not Normal · 2025-10-11. - Flasks got cheaper when their recipe changed to Golden Sansam, "like 30% cheaper" Spiff · 2025-08-14. The higher Black Lotus chance and flasks from weekly caches then pushed prices down further Jesse Potter · 2025-10-27. - Turtle custom recipes: Potion of Quickness, Lucidity Potion, Elixir of Greater Nature Power, Dreamshard Elixir (1.17.0) and Unstable Concoction (1.17.1) ([Dragunovi (staff), 2023-07-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52796#p52796)). - An Arcanite transmute earns about 6g every 2 days, so it only pays across several alts gastro · 2025-11-22. ### Enchanting - Enchant your own gear and your raid's. Turtle adds custom enchants: Bracer Spell Power (+12), Gloves Arcane/Nature Power (+20), Boots/Bracer Vampirism, Gloves Major Strength and more ([Dragunovi (staff), 2023-07-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52796#p52796)). - Enchanting supplies the **Enchanted Gemstone Oils** that Jewelcrafting needs ([official site, Jewelcrafting](https://turtlecraft.gg/jewelcrafting)). - A good leveling partner for Skinning or Tailoring: disenchant outgrown gear as you go Holidae · 2025-11-23, Snackz · 2026-02-28. You can disenchant at Enchanting skill 1 GumGuzz · 2025-11-04. - Enchanting + Jewelcrafting earns gold if you advertise Aest · 2025-12-10. Enchants, Jewelcrafting gems and belt buckles are usually sold with the buyer bringing the mats biloen · 2026-01-16. - In 1.18.1, Lesser and Greater Mystic Wand need **Bright Wood**, which comes from Woodcutting ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). ### Jewelcrafting (Turtle-custom, 1.17.2) - **What it is:** more than 200 crafts: rings, necklaces, staves, trinkets, off-hands, helmets and gemstones. It has two specialisations, chosen at skill 225 and level 40: **Goldsmith** (equipment, and most epics) and **Gemology** (gemstones) ([official site, Jewelcrafting](https://turtlecraft.gg/jewelcrafting)). Gear has no gem slots Selenya <WotF> / Flykra <WSC> · 2025-07-20. Gemstones work "like enchants", and anyone can benefit from them without a Goldsmith specialisation Akalix · 2025-06-19. - **What classes use:** - Ring and neck enchants: +6 Arcane SP for mages Junpei · 2026-01-30, +12 healing Bezawit · 2025-09-04, +Agility for rogues GumGuzz · 2026-04-05, hit for warlocks biloen · 2026-02-24, +3 all stats for warriors 30 · 2025-11-20. - Tank and vampirism pieces Blindtongue · 2025-12-01, Torbz · 2026-01-27. - Resto staves and rings Bezawit · 2025-09-13. - Warlocks prefer Gemology Karina · 2025-10-14. Goldsmith items are "just aren't good" for warriors Velanir · 2026-03-11. - **Self-sufficient:** you need Mining, plus Enchanting for the gem oils Lyrazia · 2025-07-19. **Gemstone Deposits** replace thorium veins, need Mining 310 and guarantee an Imperial Topaz ([official site](https://turtlecraft.gg/jewelcrafting)). - **Leveling:** the only 1-300 route is a player guide (pre-1.18.1, peer-corrected) ([Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106310#p106310)). Details are in `synthesis/content/professions-and-recipes.md` §3. ### Tailoring - Mostly for a few BoP items: **Robe of the Archmage** for mages (BiS until BWL, still wearable after you drop the profession) Shared · 2025-11-03, Luden TA · 2025-12-10, Mooncloth for T3 L-star · 2025-12-20, and the **Core Felcloth Bag** for warlocks Lightemgee · 2025-12-04. - The good caster crafts are BoE, so buy them: Spellwoven Nobility Drape, Gloves of Unwinding Mystery, Gloves of Spell Mastery Shared · 2025-11-07, Adamant · 2026-04-13. - Mooncloth margins are poor, about 10g per 5-day cooldown BLS · 2025-12-25. - Turtle custom patterns include Dreamthread, Cosmic, Flarecore Boots, Gloves of Unwinding Mystery and Robe of Sacrifice ([Dragunovi (staff), 2023-07-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52796#p52796)). ### Leatherworking (+ Skinning) - **Rogues:** Dreamhide Leggings (3% haste, BoP) Blindtongue · 2025-12-07 and Naxx frost-resistance crafts from Cured Rugged Hide Farban · 2026-03-12. - **Druids:** Leatherworking pieces (Dreamhide) feed the Swift Travel Form quest Izhan · 2025-01-14. Flamewrath Leggings are cat BiS Lyrazia · 2025-10-23. - **Hunters:** no Leatherworking specialisation suits hunters SliceOfBerry · 2026-03-25. - **Shamans:** it "is kinda ass" unless you refuse to trade Not Normal · 2026-01-17. - Skinning is called the worst gathering profession for gold Purge · 2026-04-17. A Cured Rugged Hide cooldown still sells for about 19-20g every 72 hours Farban · 2026-01-02. ### Blacksmithing (+ Mining) - **Contested** for warriors: "avoid like the plague" Sylvaira · 2026-01-24 against "has some good bits now", mostly pre-raid Aubreykun · 2025-12-02. - Key crafts: - Tempered Runeblade (Swordsmith chain), pre-raid BiS for Ret and warriors Mithreon · 2025-11-27, Aubreykun · 2025-12-02. - Belt buckles Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. - A fear-immunity trinket Vale Grumby · 2025-12-07. - The Fiery Chain fire-resistance set for shaman tanks poto · 2026-02-21. - **1.18.1 crafted-item upgrades (experimental):** BWL bosses drop upgrade items (e.g. an Arcanite sharpening stone) that raise specific crafted items. The upgraded weapon needs the crafting specialisation to use, e.g. Axesmith for the Reaper or Swordsmith for the Champion ([Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272)), darthpenance · 2026-04-05. Players call it "very niche and mostly just for flavor" ([Elesion (player), 2026-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173602#p173602)). ### Gathering: Herbalism, Mining, Skinning - **Herbalism** pays best through the **Dire Maul East lashers** (from about level 52-54). Prot paladins are called the best lasher farmers Iseut · 2025-05-14, Kitsu · 2025-12-09. - How much Herbalism adds is **contested**. One view is about +20% Greendam · 2025-09-26; another is "a very minor part" of lasher income Zaaparou · 2026-02-17. - Herb prices crashed in late 2025 from oversupply Faelune · 2025-12-10, Ythor · 2025-10-16. - Staff raised the lasher herb drop to 4%, and the Black Lotus chance from high-level herbs to 6% (last step 2025-10-21) ([Akalix (staff), 2024-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=90746#p90746); see `synthesis/content/professions-and-recipes.md` §7). - Druids can herb in Travel Form Lyrazia · 2024-11-14. Tauren get +15 Herbalism .• Øยgคฬค •. · 2024-08-28. - **Mining:** the best early gold Zugolas · 2025-05-04. At 60, naked ZG mining (Arcane Crystal veins) is a consistent farm Searinoxx · 2026-04-03, Mithreon · 2026-04-04. Hateforge Quarry has 2 guaranteed thorium veins on a fast reset Hakuna · 2026-03-21. **Contested:** one rogue calls Mining "a really bad gold maker" Nandieb · 2026-02-27. - **Skinning** is the cheap leveling gatherer that pays for training sailorVEVO · 2025-05-08. - You can only track one node type at a time Micro Jackson · 2025-10-06.

sections.heading: Secondary professions
sections.markdown: ### Survival (Turtle-custom; reworked in 1.18.1) **What it is.** Survival was added on 2019-05-10 as a secondary skill capped at 150. In **1.18.1** (released 2026-03-20) staff rebuilt it into "a secondary profession drawing from other primary professions". The rework has **80+ new recipes**, tools that **slow, root or trap** opponents, **bags** for the three gathering professions, containers for fish and meat, and **Woodcutting**, a wood-gathering activity tied to Survival skill ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). **Before 1.18.1 (historical):** - The crafts were the Dim Torch (+4 Spirit to the party), Bright Campfire (+8 Spirit), Traveler's Tent (rested XP), Fishing Boat (+50 Fishing), Iron Lantern, Murloc's Flippers, the **Repaired Electro-Lantern** and the Gardening planter ([official site, Survival & Gardening](https://turtlecraft.gg/survival-and-gardening)). - Tent duration is **contested**: 20 minutes on the official page, 30 minutes in the 2019 guide ([Gifted (guide writer), 2019-08-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=3641#p3641)). - Leveling: skill 76-150 unlocked automatically, and each Bright Campfire gave a guaranteed point up to 150 !!!𝗥𝗘𝗧𝗥𝗢🏹 · 2025-03-27. - Uses: - Tent-questing was the fastest way to level Dodging · 2025-11-25, Koae · 2026-01-04. - The Electro-Lantern's melee zap was an off-hand for Resto druid "tree-punching" Comentor · 2026-03-19 and a Nature spellstrike item for paladins Adamant · 2025-11-23. **The 1.18.1 rework:** - **Learning it:** progress was **reset** Mithreon · 2026-03-18. - Apprentice is available at level 1 again ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608)). - The new trainer is in Stormwind and Orgrimmar, and the old trainer no longer sells wood wiwit · 2026-03-23, sebasneitorss2 · 2026-03-21. - Journeyman: level 10 / skill 50. Expert: level 20 / skill 150, taught only by Nerean Stagtree (Desolace, Alliance) or Swampwalker Krug (Swamp of Sorrows, Horde). Artisan: level 35 / skill 225, from Rufus Hardwick (Stranglethorn) via *To Survive in the Jungle* ([Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172915#p172915); level reduced to 35 by [Torta (staff), 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173490#p173490)). - **Leveling 1-300:** - The one full route is the Speedz1337 guide. It needs a Whittle and a Woodcutting Axe from a Survival Supplier, and states a vendor cost of about 6g 62s. Everything else is gathered by Woodcutting or bought on the AH. The route and wood tiers per zone are in `synthesis/content/professions-and-recipes.md` §1.5a. - Torches now grey out at skill 15 Ixxi · 2026-03-23. Cutting trees gives no Survival skill Ragi · 2026-03-30, and trees are gated by Survival skill nabu · 2026-03-21. - Leveling it is "worse than it was before": some materials are very costly while leveling Modwolf · 2026-04-01, sosqua9- · 2026-04-04. - **What it gives:** - **Simple Slingshot:** a 20-yard ranged pull for melee, learned early Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2026-03-20, Mithreon · 2026-03-23. Paladins love it: "The Slingshot is so good" Arle · 2026-03-26. - **Arrows and ammo:** the easy tier is about 17.5 DPS Hakuna · 2026-03-20. It can make "2nd bis arrows", which you can also buy on the AH limbless · 2026-04-09, limbless · 2026-04-09. - **Emergency Parachute** cloak (30-minute cooldown) Tydorel · 2026-03-27. - **Throwable Net, Slowing Bolas** (slow and root tools; Speedz1337 guide). Warrior twinks list the nets for PvP Ionnatra · 2026-04-06, but one player calls them "disappointing" Madcrep · 2026-04-06. Bolas can proc Wrath of Cenarius (single source) Jesse Potter · 2026-03-22. - **Gathering trinkets:** the Black Lotus trinket multiplies the Black Lotus chance by 1.5, and the Arcane Crystal trinket adds a flat 2% (single source) Mithreon · 2026-04-02. Players stack them with the new Fortune flask Hexadin · 2026-03-23. There is also a skill-300 sickle that raises the Black Lotus chance ([Birtha (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171974#p171974)). - **Other crafts:** Nutritious Rations (make permanent Oranges), fishing traps, craftable bows, one-handed white weapons for Vagrant/Traveling Craftsman challenges, and a cloth head that summons a cooking fire ([Elesion (player), 2026-03-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173031#p173031)). Also an early dagger with +1 dagger skill (single source) DesignerDave · 2026-03-23. - **Tents in 1.18.1:** rested XP from kills fell to a 50% bonus, tents fill only to 25% rested, and non-city taverns reach 100% ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). Players say the nerf "wrecked tents" Black Hat · 2026-02-17, and "Tents are ass the rest is solid to use" Chubby Piglets · 2026-04-09. - **Who benefits most:** - Melee without a ranged pull (paladins, warriors, rogues) for the slingshot. The paladin channel's standard pair is "Engineering and Survival" Mithreon · 2026-03-26. - Herbalists and miners for the gathering trinkets and bags. - Hunters for ammo, though you can buy it. - Hardcore players, where "survival skills like that are super high value" Peremin · 2026-03-12. - Several channels advise leveling it only as far as the items you want, e.g. about 60 for the slingshot Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2026-03-26. - No source finds raid value for caster classes. ### Gardening (Turtle-custom; needs Survival) **What it is:** - Grow crops in planters. - **Before 1.18.1:** at level 20, take **"You Reap What You Sow"** in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore. It rewards a Shovel and a first Wooden Planter and needs **Survival 75** ([official site, Survival & Gardening](https://turtlecraft.gg/survival-and-gardening)). Trainers are Kern Mosshoof (Bloodhoof Village, Horde) and Mortimer Stansfield (outside Stormwind, Alliance) ([Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2025-06-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=136320#p136320)), Trolitobravo · 2026-03-21. - **Growth cycle:** one seed per planter, four 9-minute stages (36 minutes). Stage 2 needs Un'Goro Soil; stages 3 and 4 need Refreshing Spring Water. **Planters vanish if you log out or leave the zone** (same guide). - Since 2025, planters work anywhere except capital cities ([Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2025-10-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155377#p155377)). **1.18.1 changes:** - The Gardening quest was **reset**, so you have to redo it ([Sylveria (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171863#p171863)). - Staff announced **three new crops** with strong buffs, plus critters that raid crops ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). - A player named **four** new seeds (Wildhammer Yam Roots, Wild Grape Seeds, Ordinary Cabbage Seeds, Sandswept Carrot Seeds) ([Sagabal (player), 2026-04-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174505#p174505)). The count is **contested**. **What it gives:** - Cheap raid food: Power Mushrooms 30 · 2026-01-04, Mithreon · 2025-10-21 and Sour Mountain Berries (+10 Agility, tradeable) for rogues Epickalen · 2026-02-14. - Crops are also Survival reagents, which makes them pricey: the skill-225 quest uses them Greendam · 2026-04-10. - Semi-AFK income Arle · 2026-01-28. Lashers pay more (pre-1.18.1), but that farming isn't AFK Greendam · 2025-08-01. - Before 1.18.1, the quest's Shovel was a strong level-20 one-hander for shamans otep1616 · 2025-07-04. - **Risk:** planters despawn on a server crash, and GMs don't restore them Honzáš · 2026-04-06. **Who benefits most:** raiders who want cheap food, and players who level Survival anyway. No class needs it. ### Cooking, First Aid and Fishing - **Cooking** got 1.18.1 retunes, e.g. Hot Smoked Bass → 30 Spirit, Mightfish Steak → 20 Strength, Cooked Glossy Mightfish → 15 Spell Penetration. It also got new raid foods such as the Squid Eel Skewer (+20 Agility) and Deep Sea Stew ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). - **Fishing:** Stonescale Eels pay about 50-70g/hour Epickalen · 2025-11-19, Ordinary Joe · 2026-01-08. - **First Aid:** Turtle adds Powerful Smelling Salts (1.17.0) ([Dragunovi (staff), 2023-07-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52796#p52796)).

sections.heading: Race interactions
sections.markdown: - **Goblin:** the Prospecting racial grants Mining *and* Jewelcrafting skill ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102965#p102965)). Some Engineering recipes are Goblin-only (rocket boots). The race-change trick is to craft Gnome-only BoP items first, then play Goblin (single source) roguecraft · 2026-03-30. - **Tauren:** +15 Herbalism .• Øยgคฬค •. · 2024-08-28. - **Paladins** can only be Human, Dwarf or High Elf, so no race profession trick applies to them Destroses · 2026-03-27.

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - **Dire Maul East lashers** (with Herbalism) are the standard gold farm for mages, paladins, shamans, warlocks and priests from about level 52 Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-10-30, Zamka · 2025-10-09. Druids farm them poorly because lashers are Nature-immune Aecheur · 2026-03-28. - **Zul'Gurub** kite and mining farms suit hunters and rogues Meta · 2026-03-18, Purge · 2026-04-17. - **Cooldown alts:** transmutes and Mooncloth earn about 200-300g a week (single source) Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-03. - Warriors struggle to farm gold solo; the usual workaround is grouping up (tank dungeons, PvP, or auto-follow a friend for scraps) Aubreykun · 2025-11-19.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
- Staff never published full recipe lists for Survival's 80+ crafts or Jewelcrafting's 200+ items. Skill thresholds exist only in the two player leveling guides.
- The Gemology questline and recipes are undocumented in text.
- It is unresolved where Enchanted Thorium Shells drop, and what the 1.18.1 caster goggles are called and their exact stats.
- No source has measured how much the Survival nets, bolas and trinkets are worth, or checked whether the Survival and Engineering parachutes share a cooldown.
- The Gardening crop count is contested (three vs four).
- No source measures Engineering's raid value after the Battle Chicken timer change.

guides.recommendation: On almost every class, level with **two gathering professions** for gold. At 60, drop one and take **Engineering**, which is the only profession that directly adds raid damage or threat (Goblin Sapper Charges, grenades, Battle Chicken, Force Reactive Disk). Keep **Herbalism** if you farm the Dire Maul East lashers, or **Mining** if you farm Zul'Gurub. Take a crafting profession only for a specific BoP item your spec needs, and buy BoE crafts instead of leveling a profession for them. Add **Survival**, the reworked secondary profession, for the slingshot ranged pull, ammo and gathering tools. Class pages: [Druid](#/class/druid/professions) · [Hunter](#/class/hunter/professions) · [Mage](#/class/mage/professions) · [Paladin](#/class/paladin/professions) · [Priest](#/class/priest/professions) · [Rogue](#/class/rogue/professions) · [Shaman](#/class/shaman/professions) · [Warlock](#/class/warlock/professions) · [Warrior](#/class/warrior/professions).

guides.title: PvP on Turtle WoW 1.18.1
guides.intro: **Short answer:** in 1.18.1 honor is a **currency** with a **20,000 honor per week cap**. Rank Points come in with each honor gain, and you are promoted the moment you have enough. You buy three tiers of PvP sets from the Rank 6 hall; the top tier also needs **Conquest**, which was still not earnable weeks after release. For honor, play the daily **Call to Arms** battleground, keep your marks for its turn-in, and don't bother with Warmode unless you want to be ganked for +5% XP. For class matchups, specs and PvP talent builds see the class pages: [Druid](#/class/druid/balance-pvp) · [Hunter](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-pvp) · [Mage](#/class/mage/arcane-pvp) · [Paladin](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp) · [Priest](#/class/priest/discipline-pvp) · [Rogue](#/class/rogue/assassination-pvp) · [Shaman](#/class/shaman/elemental-pvp) · [Warlock](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp) · [Warrior](#/class/warrior/arms-pvp). Before you start: Turtle is a PvE-first network. Its players sum it up as "BG's pop often, no world pvp, arenas exist but they are horrible" betcover · 2025-10-14 and "pvp is side quest here, its PvE server" AxenPunker · 2025-10-14. The #pvp-general export ends on 2025-11-01, so everything below that carries only a pvp-general citation dates from before 1.18.1. Where 2026 posts in the class channels or staff forum posts confirm or overturn it, this page says so.

sections.heading: Honor, rank and PvP gear
sections.markdown: ### Honor is a currency now - Since 1.18.1 honor is credited immediately and spent at vendors. There is no longer a weekly standings race for your spot ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)). Players sum it up as: "Rank points decay. Rank doesn't decay. Honor is just a currency, it doesn't decay" Grey · 2026-03-28. - All honor gains were cut to **10%** of their old values, and prices were rescaled to match ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)). - **Weekly cap: 20,000 honor** Dodging · 2026-03-28, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-28. It resets at the weekly maintenance, which is also when the Rank Point decay hits Jesse Potter · 2026-04-07. - **Weekly reset:** the night from Tuesday to Wednesday, EU time Pastor · 2025-10-25, usually after the server restart Meow · 2025-10-29. A 2026 post on a Tuesday confirms the cap reset Jesse Potter · 2026-04-07. - **How long capping takes:** estimates run from about 13 hours casey · 2026-04-11 to about 20 hours a week Porkins · 2026-04-09, Allie :3 · 2026-04-02. Sample gains: - 15 AB, 3 WSG and 6 AV (mostly won) gave 7,855 honor in a week Crane | Korault · 2026-03-31. - 2 AB wins plus 1 WSG loss gave 348 honor Beldrin · 2026-04-01. - A battleground objective is worth 25 honor, or 50 on the bonus day Silverhand · 2026-03-28, Silverhand · 2026-03-28. - **Transition:** you kept your old rank, and got a one-time honor bonus based on it ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)). For the mid-week launch, players also got half of the old flush RP ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139)). ### What gives honor (and what doesn't) These rules were posted before 1.18.1. Nothing in 2026 contradicts them, but treat them as possibly stale. - **Level gap:** you get no honor from a target more than 12 levels below you (a 60 still gets honor from a 48), and grey-level targets give none Jesse Potter · 2025-10-25, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-25, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-25. - **Who shares a kill:** honor counts if you are in the killer's party, if you are within about 50 yd in a battleground, or if you damaged the target in the open world while not in a party Jesse Potter · 2025-10-25. - **Level within a bracket:** a character at the top of a bracket gets less honor for killing lower-level players in it dark · 2025-10-30, lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-30. - **Same faction:** same-faction kills don't give Honorable Kills Cysthen · 2025-10-24. **Contested:** after cross-faction BGs arrived, Jesse Potter said killing your own faction was giving HKs and honor and needed a fix Jesse Potter · 2025-10-27. - **Same IP:** killing players connected from your IP gives no honor ([Torta (staff), 2025-02-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120933#p120933)). - **Dishonorable Kills:** **Contested.** Players said there were no DHKs on Turtle Kyrsie · 2025-10-25. Staff first removed them, then said grey-level kills would give DHKs, then said they were "still disabled" ([Akalix (staff), 2023-12-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=80586#p80586), [Torta (staff), 2023-12-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=80839#p80839), [Akalix (staff), 2024-01-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84944#p84944)). - **Titles:** 100,000 Honorable Kills gives a title of its own, separate from rank Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26, MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-26. - **Leaving AV early:** you lose only the bonus honor. The honor tab just doesn't update until you reload or change zone Pastor · 2026-03-28. Pastor's rule of thumb: "See if it will end in 30 minutes. If not, leave" Pastor · 2026-03-28. ### Rank and Rank Points - Every honor gain also gives Rank Points. You are promoted as soon as you reach the next rank's threshold. RP decays every week but cannot take a rank away ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)). The no-de-rank rule dates from 2023 ([Akalix (staff), 2023-10-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=67818#p67818)). **Contested:** after 1.18.1 some players reported being de-ranked or showing Rank 0 ([Xerony (player), 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173497#p173497), [Leilar (player), 2026-04-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175607#p175607)). - **Rank 13 → 14** is reported at about 80k honor (hearsay) Allie :3 · 2026-04-02. - **Level caps on rank:** twinks can't out-rank their level, as in vanilla's level limits Boomsky · 2026-04-01. At levels 40-49 the cap is about Rank 9 Xerq · 2026-04-01, Kyrsie · 2025-10-04. In the 30s it is about Rank 5 awry · 2025-10-08, and at 59 you can reach Rank 13 Kyrsie · 2025-10-04. For the first three days after the patch you could rank past the cap, and the next maintenance set those ranks back Jamx · 2026-04-01. - **The PvP hall and its vendors** need **Rank 6** (Knight on Alliance) to enter Porkins · 2026-04-09, Mithreon · 2026-03-28. You can't turn in marks there limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2025-10-24. ### The 1.18.1 PvP sets The old two-tier rank sets can no longer be bought (you keep them if you have them). They were replaced by three tiers for each armor type and role: **Tier 1 rare ~ilvl 71, Tier 2 epic ~ilvl 77, Tier 3 epic ~ilvl 92** poto · 2026-03-11. Players name them **Combatant's and Partisan's** (honor only) and **Veteran's** (honor plus Conquest) Grey · 2026-03-28. Each tier needs the tier before it Dariofern · 2026-03-31. | Tier | Total cost (Thirtyseven) | Weeks at the 20k cap | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | T1 (rare) | 24,000 honor | ~1 | Fresh-60 viable | | T2 (epic) | 144,000 honor + the T1 set | ~5 | ~20k honor per piece; players think it needs about Rank 13 Hopestotem · 2026-03-30 | | T3 (epic) | 520,000 honor + the T2 set + 21,000 Conquest | ~18 + ~7 for Conquest | Pieces ~95-100k honor and 3.5-4k Conquest Excinerus · 2026-03-28, Beldrin · 2026-04-01 | Source for the totals: "the MINIMUM time you can spend is 8+ months, 33 weeks" Thirtyseven · 2026-04-11. The new off-set pieces add close to 40k honor more Thirtyseven · 2026-04-11. PvP weapons don't need Conquest poto · 2026-03-30, but the new trinket needs 250 Conquest Beldrin · 2026-04-08. More crit-reduction PvP pieces reached the vendors around 2026-04-08 Vent · 2026-04-08. Opinions on the sets range from "utter garbage compared to PVE gear sets" to a T3 piece being the new bear threat BiS ([Moomoobro (player), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172842#p172842), 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-03-30). The class pages cover which pieces each class wants. ### Conquest Points - **Planned sources:** Conquest was announced to come from high rated-arena rating (paid at the weekly flush), from the world PvP events, and from Call to Arms battlegrounds (paid immediately) ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)). The Tier 3 set, the trinket and some off-set pieces need it Beldrin · 2026-04-08, Beldrin · 2026-04-08. - **Status:** on 2026-04-08, asked whether anyone could earn Conquest, Thirtyseven answered "not available yet" Thirtyseven · 2026-04-08. On 2026-04-17 another player said "conquest is disabled anyway" Suade · 2026-04-17. Players expected every Conquest source to arrive in one update together with the world PvP objectives Jesse Potter · 2026-04-08. One shaman on 2026-04-17 said he was "working on conquest points for trinket" Wahisky · 2026-04-17, which conflicts with the other reports. Treat Conquest as **not live**; the servers closed on 2026-05-15.

sections.heading: Battlegrounds
sections.markdown: ### Queueing and cross-faction - **Queue from anywhere:** use the crossed-swords icon at the minimap dindunuffinz · 2025-10-13. In late March 2026 the minimap finder had the wrong level requirements for Arathi Basin and Thorn Gorge; the 2026-03-31 hotfix corrected them ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173490#p173490)). - **Cross-faction:** since 4 November 2025, PvE realms can put you on the other faction's team when one side is short ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157078#p157078)). You can't queue a mixed-faction premade ([Jamey (staff), 2025-11-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158392#p158392)), and the queue tries same-faction matches first ([Jamey (staff), 2025-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159238#p159238)). Tel'Abim, the PvP realm, has no cross-faction interaction ([Torta (staff), 2023-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=66566#p66566)). - **No combat escape:** you can't enter a battleground while PvP-flagged and in combat ([Akalix (staff), 2024-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=90751#p90751)). - **Faction balance before cross-faction:** Horde queues often took over an hour while Alliance popped instantly Bipst · 2025-10-19. Players put Horde's pug win rate at about 80% betcover · 2025-10-14. ### Call to Arms (the daily bonus battleground) - One battleground a day carries the bonus. You can check which one at the city emissaries or on turtle-timer.vercel.app Jaki · 2025-10-24. Before 1.18.1 the order was **AV → WSG → AB → Blood Ring → Sunnyglade** Nandieb · 2025-10-26. - **1.18.1:** Sunnyglade Valley was disabled for a rework ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168), Jesse Potter · 2026-02-17), and its emissaries were replaced by Thorn Gorge emissaries ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173490#p173490)). That Thorn Gorge takes Sunnyglade's slot in the rotation is an inference; no Discord post confirms it. - **How to farm it:** on its bonus day, queue only that battleground and save the marks. After the third day (AB), turn them all in for the "greater honor" quest Nandieb · 2025-10-26. The quest pays a fixed amount no matter how many sets of marks you hand in Xerq · 2025-10-29. - **Where to turn in:** marks go to the capital's king's hall, and the class of the character doesn't matter. You gain reputation and honor limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2025-10-24. - **Blood Ring day** comes round about every five days. It is one of the few times people queue for the Blood Ring lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-15. ### Warsong Gulch - **Flag-carrier debuff:** it stacks the longer the carrier holds the flag. At about **18 stacks** the carrier dies in two hits, so it works as a soft timer Jesse Potter · 2025-10-09. - **Resetting it:** dropping and re-grabbing the flag doesn't clear the stacks; only a capture does Jesse Potter · 2025-10-08, Thirtyseven · 2025-10-08, awry · 2025-10-08. One player adds that about 10 minutes without holding the flag also clears them (single source) awry · 2025-10-08. - **Known bug (Oct 2025):** if both teams return their flags and re-pick them at about the same time, the stacks don't refresh, and the new carrier can start with 10 or more Pastor · 2025-10-03. - **No game timer:** stalled games have run 50+ minutes ormeyer · 2025-10-09. - **Help you can't give the carrier:** - Blessing of Protection and Divine Intervention can't be cast on a carrier unless the flag is dropped manually first ([Torta (staff), 2024-01-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=83488#p83488)). - A carrier can stay stealthed, but casting stealth drops the flag ([Torta (staff), 2024-01-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84147#p84147)). - **Dust of Disappearance** was nerfed after it was used to force enemy carriers to drop the flag Souri · 2025-10-06, Souri · 2025-10-06. - **Power-up respawns:** Food 20 s, Berserk 120 s, Speed 150 s ([Torta (staff), 2022-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=30582#p30582)). - **Jump spots:** staff chose to discourage them rather than remove them Akalix · 2025-06-10. Some Classic jumps don't work on Turtle, and male vs female models can matter Grillbe · 2025-10-05, Pastor · 2025-10-05. - **Picking up the flag:** scroll-wheel pickup is not baseline on the 1.12 client Pastor · 2025-10-20. - **Hunting the carrier:** set your nameplates to enemy players only, so totems, pets and friendlies don't get in the way Jesse Potter · 2025-10-09. Class-specific carrier advice is on the class pages. ### Alterac Valley - AV is the only battleground with an inactivity debuff 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-15. Being AFK in any battleground is against the rules and can get you a suspension ([Pepesmite (staff), 2024-06-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=96257#p96257)). - Before 1.18.1, AV games could drag on for 1.5-2 hours. The losing side still collected a roughly 3k honor bonus from objectives and kills, so many players didn't try to win Duszman · 2025-10-29, Duszman · 2025-10-29. Those numbers predate the 10% honor rescale. - Korrak's health has been cut to a quarter of the original, so one player can kill him ([Torta (staff), 2023-06-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=51551#p51551)). ### Thorn Gorge (new in 1.18.1) - **Format:** an Eye of the Storm-style 15v15. You capture flags and bases until one side reaches the resource cap ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). - **Level:** the minimum was lowered to **31** on 2026-03-24 ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139)). For a while after that you couldn't queue it from the map Jamx · 2026-03-25. - **Hotfixes:** power-ups were added on 2026-03-24 ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139)). On 2026-04-14 flag pickup stopped being affected by haste and honor went up 50% ([Torta (staff), 2026-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175230#p175230)). - There is no shapeshifting while you carry its flag Hopestotem · 2026-04-10. ### Rules for every battleground - **Transmog and illusions:** transmog doesn't show inside battlegrounds Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12, and illusion items can't be used there Pastor · 2025-10-22. - **Consumables:** they are deliberately lost when you die in a battleground ([Akalix (staff), 2024-02-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=86655#p86655)). - **Cooldowns:** spell cooldowns reset when you enter a battleground or resurrect in one ([Torta (staff), 2019-11-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=4490#p4490)). - **Leveling in battlegrounds:** battlegrounds give XP, and the losing side still levels well lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-29. In 1.18.1 players still level in AB on its bonus day Tim · 2026-04-02. Hardcore characters get no battleground XP ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=155594#p155594)). - **Twink brackets:** at 19 and 29, non-twinks are reported to be badly outclassed by twinks Gnomeburger Orgon · 2025-10-27.

sections.heading: Blood Ring and arenas
sections.markdown: ### Blood Ring - **What it is:** Turtle's 3v3 arena, with its own reputation, the **Steamwheedle Blood Ring** ([Torta (staff), 2023-10-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=71607#p71607)). - **Arena rules:** - World buffs are removed when you enter. - Pet trinkets are disabled. - Mana is unlimited during the preparation phase. - Soul Shards are refunded after the match. - Source: [Akalix (staff), 2023-12-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=80586#p80586). - **Reputation rewards:** - The **Bloody Gladiator** helm and shoulders, in plate evella · 2026-02-04 and mail Grey · 2025-12-11 versions, plus rings Ruth · 2025-09-25. - A Weaponsmith dagger recipe that needs Exalted plus Blood tokens Blindtongue · 2025-11-04, Lightemgee · 2026-01-08. - On Ambershire the rewards were released later than the reputation itself Nandieb · 2025-12-07, Nandieb · 2026-01-08. - **Title:** **Blood Ring Champion** needs max reputation with the Blood Ring, beyond plain Exalted Thirtyseven · 2025-10-15, Thirtyseven · 2025-10-15. Exalted with the Steamwheedle Cartel doesn't count Tapka · 2025-08-26. ### Rated arena and skirmishes - 1.18.0 added a new arena map, 2v2 and rated teams ([Jamey (staff), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134968#p134968)). - **Before 1.18.1** the arena population was tiny: one player got to rank 1 with a single 10-0 session Pastor · 2025-10-12. - Matchmaking often stopped finding games, and the only fix was to disband the team MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-12. - Overflow arena tokens were supposed to arrive by mail, but after about 100 games one player had received none betcover · 2025-10-31. - Gear swaps and pre-match consumables were allowed Pastor · 2025-10-30. - **After 1.18.1:** on 2026-03-21 new arena teams couldn't be created, and solo skirmishes kicked you out when the doors opened Cysthen · 2026-03-21. Group queueing for skirmish was fixed on 2026-04-14 ([Torta (staff), 2026-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175230#p175230)). The announced restrictions on cooldowns and consumables in rated arena have no confirmed go-live date ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)).

sections.heading: World PvP and Warmode
sections.markdown: - **Warmode** makes you permanently PvP-flagged. You toggle it at a capital Battlemaster Hotdiggity · 2025-10-29, and it ends at level 60 ([Torta (staff), 2025-08-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144045#p144045)). - **Bonus:** since the 2025 change it is just +5% XP, and it is no longer offered at character creation Cysthen · 2025-10-28. A 2026 answer confirms the +5% and adds "Youll get ganked" Epickalen · 2026-03-28. - **Why it changed:** staff blamed level-1 "Lunatic" players killing brand-new characters during their intro cinematic, and said that experience won't come back ([Torta (staff), 2025-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161360#p161360)). Players agree Lunatics were the reason for the change Pastor · 2025-10-15, and say it killed what world PvP was left: "There is no wpvp on Nord anymore" GeneralSecretary · 2025-10-28. - **Warmode on Tel'Abim:** it isn't available there ([Torta (staff), 2023-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=66566#p66566)). - **How much world PvP there is:** very little. It is "virtually nonexistant on Nordranar" Zestitcha · 2025-10-23, and one player leveled with Warmode on without meeting any cavillis · 2026-03-28. - **Zone PvP quest:** get 5 killing blows in a zone that fits your level, for PvP currency and a lot of XP 1.18.1 WILL SAVE US #LetThemCook · 2025-10-29. - **Redwall Keep and Southshore vs Tarren Mill:** these 1.18.1 world PvP objectives were meant to give honor and Conquest ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). Redwall Keep is a new fortress in Redridge Jesse Potter · 2025-10-30, so it is a low-level event Jesse Potter · 2026-02-20. **Contested:** staff said the events would go live "shortly after the release", but players were still asking where they were on 2026-04-15 ([Gramrock (player), 2026-04-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175348#p175348)). Treat them as never having gone live. - **Opting out of PvP on PvE realms:** don't turn on Warmode, don't attack the other faction, avoid PvP quests, and keep your flag off. Battlegrounds and the Blood Ring are opt-in ([Pepesmite (staff), 2023-09-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=65951#p65951)).

sections.heading: Dampening and resilience
sections.markdown: - **Dampening in 1.18.0** was flat: player physical damage -15%, magical damage -20%, incoming player healing -20%, absorbs -15%, and mana costs -20% in battlegrounds and arenas ([Jamey (staff), 2025-06-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134968#p134968)). - **Dampening in 1.18.1** depends on class and spec ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). The numbers were never published, and players asked where to look them up Boltzmann · 2026-04-01. Players noticed a dampening change around 2026-04-03 Eepyman · 2026-04-04. BM hunter pets were reported undampened limbless · 2026-04-12. - **Resilience** reduces critical damage and damage-over-time taken. guides.title: Client, launcher and addons on Turtle WoW 1.18.1
guides.intro:
**Short answer:** Turtle runs the 2006 **1.12 client**, not Classic, so modern macros and many addon features only work once you add client mods. The usual stack is **Nampower** (spell queueing), **SuperWoW** (longer macros, hidden buffs, better combat log) and **UnitXP** (line of sight and distance), with a macro addon such as **SuperCleveRoidMacros** on top. If something breaks after a patch, try these in order: remove or update **patch-O**, delete the **WDB** folder, launch through the official launcher so it patches fully, and clear your GPU **shader cache** if spell visuals get stuck on screen. Class-specific macros live on the class pages (links at the bottom).

Most messages cited here come from the weeks around the 1.18.1 release (live 2026-03-20). Anything older is marked as possibly stale.

sections.heading: Macro basics on the 1.12 client
sections.markdown: ### What isn't native - `#showtooltip`, `/startattack`, `/stopcasting`, `/castsequence` and `/equip` are **not 1.12 commands**. They come from macro addons Elesion · 2025-03-25, Mewtiny · 2024-11-26. - Without an addon, `#showtooltip` just prints itself into chat and throws a `/help` error ! upandadamw · 2025-09-01. For a tooltip that updates as the macro changes, use CleverMacro or CleveRoid-family addons Mewtiny · 2024-11-05. - **Mouseover:** 1.12 has no native mouseover. Use `/pfcast` (pfUI), `/lunamo` (Luna), `/ngcast` (NotGrid) or a Roid-style `[@mouseover]` stochastic · 2024-08-29. - **`@cursor`** doesn't exist stochastic · 2024-08-29. Use Nampower quickcast instead. - **Pets:** `/petattack` doesn't work for hunters, so use `/script PetAttack(target)` Rpecial · 2025-12-30. `/run PetFollow()` works for follow Rangtuk · 2026-04-12. You can also bind pet commands directly: one of the "secondary action bars" in the Keybinds menu is the pet bar limbless · 2026-04-12, limbless · 2026-04-12. - **One action per press:** you can't automate gameplay. Luke (staff): "General rule is 1 action = 1 input from the player" Luke · 2026-01-12. ### Length limits - **255 characters by default, 511 with SuperWoW.** If your macro window allows 511, SuperWoW is running RUTHINAS · 2024-05-10. - **A single line over 255 characters crashes the game** once the macro is on an action bar Don't ping me · 2025-11-28, McPewPew · 2025-08-20. ### Which macro addon | Addon | Notes | |---|---| | **SuperMacro** | Longer macros and script functions. Its own docs say not to run it with other macro addons. Running it with Roid made macros on the bars change into other spells Rahakesh | Maik · 2026-01-01, Lipibidy · 2026-01-01, Lipibidy · 2026-01-01 | | **Roid-Macros** | Conditionals, `/startattack`, `/equip`, mouseover ugoboom · 2024-05-07, stochastic · 2024-08-29 | | **SuperCleveRoidMacros (SCRM)** | The current standard. Old CleverRoidMacros "wont work", so use SCRM poisonouscabbage · 2026-02-03. Adds `/equipmh` / `/equipoh`, `[@mouseover help alive]` and more Don't ping me · 2025-10-31, poisonouscabbage · 2026-01-25 | ### Syntax pitfalls - **Use `equipped:`, not `worn:`.** "worn is not a conditional, equipped is" Don't ping me · 2026-01-10. Example: `/cast [equipped:Daggers] Backstab` Kyrsie · 2026-03-30. - **`/equip` with random-suffix items:** leave off the "of the Bear" part. "Of the animal is not part of the name" Weirdthing · 2025-12-09, Black Hat · 2026-04-05. - **No cascading conditions on one buff.** SCRM rejected `[mybuff:"Zeal">#2&"Zeal"<10]`. Split it into two `/cast` lines, one for stacks and one for duration Sock · 2025-12-30, Mithreon · 2025-12-30, Sock · 2025-12-30. - **In SCRM, `/` means OR and `&` means AND.** A December 2025 update briefly made both behave as one operator before the maintainer fixed it. Recheck buff-guard macros after SCRM updates alyflex · 2025-12-08, Don't ping me · 2025-12-10. - **The 32-buff cap:** past 32 visible buffs, `nomybuff` checks can't see your buff and keep recasting it. One druid's macro spammed Tiger's Fury at the cap Kelushka · 2026-03-09. Another player removes Tiger's Fury from the macro in big raids Comentor · 2026-01-04. - **`!` prefix (`/cast !Auto Shot`, `!Stealth`):** **Contested.** One hunter says no `!` macro works, even with addons Thula Wena · 2026-02-06. Others use `/cast !Stealth` and `/cast !Dire Bear Form` with a Roid-family addon Not · 2026-02-16, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-03-24, Darkaco · 2026-03-27. - **Weapon swaps in combat cost a GCD per swap** and can't happen while the GCD is running Rangtuk · 2026-04-02. ### Portable script macros - **Auto Shot without toggling it off:** `/run for i=1,120 do if IsAutoRepeatAction(i) then return end end CastSpellByName("Auto Shot")` Elmgren · 2025-10-21. Checking your Auto Shot's own slot number is cheaper than looping Bakingsoda · 2025-10-21. - **Target the nearest enemy if you have none, then send the pet:** `/script if GetUnitName("target")==nil then TargetNearestEnemy() end` + `/script PetAttack(target)` Sofie · 2026-03-17. - **`TargetNearestEnemy()` limits:** it only runs from a key press, cycles rather than picking the nearest mob, and can grab out-of-combat mobs Deleted User · 2025-02-15 (pre-1.18.1).

guides.title: Game mechanics and systems (Turtle WoW 1.18.1)
guides.intro:
**Short answer:** Turtle has server rules that no class page covers. Tier sets can be swapped to another spec, but T1/T2 swaps are one-way. Most same-stat buffs don't stack, and Turtle's custom stat procs don't stack with vanilla buffs such as Juju Power. Most consumables stay on you through death. Enchants come from players, Jewelcrafting and a few NPC quest-givers, and fresh loot needs a relog before you can enchant it. Nordanaar and Ambershire have cross-faction raids; Tel'Abim, the PvP realm, does not. Everything below is player-reported from Discord unless a staff quote is named. Where players disagree it is marked **Contested**.

Related pages: [Professions](#/professions) · [Instances](#/instances) · [World bosses](#/instances/world-bosses).

sections.heading: Tier sets: spec exchange and drop bugs
sections.markdown: ### Where to swap | Tier | Where | Rules | |---|---|---| | T1 (Molten Core), T2 (Blackwing Lair) | NPC in the room in the middle of Blackrock Mountain. Walk the chains there Stunfisk · 2026-03-29, Dreward · 2025-09-07 | **One-way.** Once you turn a piece into another spec's version you can't undo it Olivaar of Moments · 2025-10-22, Zhafu · 2025-07-06. To get the original spec back you have to loot a new piece Greendam · 2025-09-24 | | T2.5 (AQ40), T3 (Naxxramas) | **Feid Rota** in Ratchet, near the bank, the "quest reward swapper" Vakos · 2024-12-01, Mithreon · 2025-09-22, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-11-01 | Can be swapped again Scatty · 2025-10-26. Feid Rota changes quest rewards; he doesn't handle a quest's first completion chain · 2025-02-05. His list has several pages, so click through them Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-07-08 | | T3.5 | None | Can't be swapped 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-11-01 | - **The T1/T2 swap quest only shows up while the original piece is in your bags.** If you vendored it, there's nothing to swap Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-22, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22. - The warrior and warlock T1/T2 swap quests were made repeatable like the other classes' (patch note quoted 2025-06) ShookeeShook · 2025-06-06. - **If an item won't show up at the swapper,** players found they had to take off their gear and bank everything except the piece they wanted to swap (2025-07, pre-1.18.1) ShookeeShook · 2025-07-08. - **Uniqueness:** only Turtle's new tier sets are Unique. On original sets you can hold duplicates of the same piece in two specs, but not a second copy of a unique one Scatty · 2025-10-26. ### Known loot-table bugs - **Paladin T1 shoulders drop at 8%,** while other classes' tier shoulders drop at about 33% Lyrazia · 2026-03-13, Lyrazia · 2026-02-23. A tester said the other T1 drop rates are fine Lyrazia · 2026-02-23. It was still 8% in April 2026, after 1.18.1 Rindal · 2026-04-13, Lyrazia · 2026-04-17. The shoulders drop from a shared group and have to "beat" three other items at about 20% each Lyrazia · 2026-04-17. A rogue said all shoulders had been fixed after a halved drop rate (2026-01), but the April paladin reports say otherwise Epickalen · 2026-01-22. - **Paladin and shaman T2 legs from Ragnaros** could only drop once per kill, while other classes' legs could drop twice. Staff confirmed this was a bug and said it would be fixed "with the next update" (2026-03-13) Nabwek · 2026-03-13. On 2026-03-24 players were still asking whether the fix was live Skylead · 2026-03-24. - In BWL, Nefarian and Chromaggus give paladins and shamans their tier in both loot tables, like other classes. sections.heading: Buff, debuff and proc stacking
sections.markdown: ### Same-stat buffs - **For any one stat, only the biggest buff counts.** Firewater, Juju Power, Elixir of the Giants and Juju Might don't stack with each other. The exception is the Blasted Lands buffs (R.O.I.D.S., Ground Scorpok Assay), which stack with Giants or Mongoose Virasan · 2026-02-16, Kyrsie · 2025-10-31. - Juju Power doesn't stack with Elixir of the Giants 30 · 2025-11-22, Beldrin · 2025-10-15. Scrolls of Agility and Strength don't stack with Mongoose or Giants Micro Jackson · 2025-10-31. - **Movement speed:** only the highest movement-speed bonus applies, but mount-speed and swim-speed bonuses do stack Darkaco · 2026-04-18. ### Turtle procs vs vanilla buffs - "It's just a known issue that twow ap,str,sp procs dont stack with vanilla/vmangoes ap,str,sp buffs" Zhafu · 2026-03-11. Examples: the Karazhan mace proc "has never stacked" with Juju Power silverthornn · 2025-12-20, 30 · 2025-12-20, and Untamed Blade reportedly doesn't stack with it either Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-03-11. ### Boss debuffs - **Attack-speed and damage-reduction debuffs on a boss don't stack.** Only the strongest one applies, and Thunderfury overwrites the rest. Dream's Herald's effect used to stack but no longer does (2026-01) 30 · 2026-01-05, 30 · 2026-01-05. - **Timbermaw Hold item bug (2026-03):** one TMH drop has a 150-armor debuff proc. It overwrites Sunder Armor and Improved Expose Armor, and stops them being reapplied until it falls off. The reporter planned to file a bug Cannondorf · 2026-03-29, Cannondorf · 2026-03-29. See [Timbermaw Hold](#/instances/timbermaw-hold). ### What can't trigger what - **Extra attacks:** according to one player reading the vmangos code, Windfury (weapon and totem), Sword Specialization and Hand of Justice all set the same extra-attack flag. While it is set, none of the others can proc (single source) Excinerus · 2026-02-02. - **Aura damage** such as Lightning Shield or Pure Essence never procs "on spell hit" items, because it is coded like Thorns. Flametongue and Thunder Lizard cloak procs are real spells (2025-08, pre-1.18.1) Rinzu · 2025-08-08. - **Minions don't attack training dummies,** so dummy tests don't show their damage (see [Training dummies](#/mechanics)). ### Debuff cap - The client shows 16 debuff slots. Past that, debuffs start taking buff slots 30 · 2025-10-05, Pepopo · 2025-06-19. Addons like Cursive and DoiteAuras can track debuffs beyond what the client shows Doite · 2026-04-14. - **Contested, total cap:** one player says the limit was raised to 64, "so the limit is not really an issue" steez · 2025-10-04. A warlock says debuffs above 32 are active but invisible, and stacked debuffs can still look like they fell off Sitgarath · 2025-11-26, Sitgarath · 2025-11-26. The DoiteAuras author tracks 16 visible slots plus 32 more, 48 in total Doite · 2026-01-10, Doite · 2026-04-14. Whatever the true number, the 16-slot display means debuff-based addons and WeakAura-style trackers can miss your debuffs in raids Mithreon · 2025-10-22.

sections.heading: Consumable rules
sections.markdown: ### Death - **Almost every consumable lasts through death in raids.** "It's pretty much only alcohol, juju, food buffs that you lose on death" Aelgagar · 2026-01-17, Aelgagar · 2026-01-17. Jujus fade on death 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-02-24, Silverhand · 2026-01-26. - Elixir of the Giants lasts 1 hour and stays through death Virasan · 2025-11-01. Dreamtonic now does too, though it didn't before (2025-11) Promey · 2025-11-06. Blackroot Brew plus Dreamtonic is a common 60-minute pair for Strength and AP Jesse Potter · 2026-04-16, Beldrin · 2026-04-16. - Spirit of Zanza was listed as not lasting through death (2025-10) Beldrin · 2025-10-15. ### Concoctions - **A concoction doesn't stack with the elixirs it contains.** If you use concoctions, drop Elixir of the Giants, Mongoose and Arcane Elixir keungzhe · 2026-02-23, keungzhe · 2026-02-23, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-07. - Different concoctions used to fail to stack with each other, because the two 35-spell-power ones shared a spell ID Grey · 2026-02-15. The patch of 2026-02-18 fixed it: "Fixed an issue causing Alchemy concoctions to not stack correctly" Pastor · 2026-02-18. ### Shared cooldowns | Item | Shares a cooldown with | Source | |---|---|---| | Goblin Sapper Charge | Stratholme Holy Water | Scruff · 2025-09-26, Farban · 2025-12-16 | | Potion of Quickness | Protection potions | Scruff · 2025-09-26 | | Frozen Rune | Puts Thistle Tea on cooldown, but Tea doesn't put Runes on cooldown | Rheinwg · 2025-12-16, Scruff · 2025-12-16 | | Night Dragon's Breath | Mana gems and runes ("if I recall") | Eubo · 2026-02-09 | | Spellstone (warlock) | Healthstone | Lightemgee · 2025-08-13 | | Nordanaar Herbal Tea | Nothing: 2-minute cooldown separate from potions; about 600 HP and 1,100 mana; 5 for 1 small Dream Shard in Hyjal | Grey · 2026-03-23 | **Contested: Thistle Tea and Healthstones.** Rogues call it "the most infuriating shared cd" Scruff · 2025-12-16 and asked the devs to change it Jiggy · 2025-07-26. A warrior theorycrafter says "tea/healthstone doesnt share cd" 30 · 2025-10-09. One player thinks the order matters, with Tea first Lightemgee · 2025-12-16. Test it yourself before counting on both. ### Other stacking notes - Spirit of Zanza doesn't stack with Lung Juice 30 · 2025-12-26. ### MP5 ticks *Pre-1.18.1 (2025-03), from a player citing the wiki. Nothing later contradicts it.* - MP5 from gear, Mageblood Potion and Mana Oil ticks every 2 seconds whether you are casting or not, and ignores the five-second rule. 10 MP5 gives 4 mana every 2 seconds Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-03-27. - Mana food (Sagefish, Nightfin) ticks on its own 5-second timer. It still stacks and gives its full mana (Nightfin 960 over 10 minutes, Sagefish 1,080 over 15), so "food is bugged" is a myth. Stat addons just show confusing numbers Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-03-27. ### Juju sourcing - Trade Winterfall E'ko in Winterspring, 3 E'ko for 3 Juju Beldrin · 2025-10-15, Beldrin · 2025-08-20. E'ko supply swings with how many people are farming Aubreykun · 2025-12-22.

sections.heading: Flask of Petrified Gold (1.18.1)
sections.markdown: - A new trinket with **25% Fortune**, from the new optional BWL boss (the goblin/ogre boss added in 1.18.1). The same boss drops a staff and a spell-power upgrade for Engineering goggles ScoobertDoobert · 2026-03-23, Nuian · 2026-03-30. See [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair). - **Fortune multiplies proc chance; it doesn't add to it.** Staff member Meflor: "hoj goes from 2% to 2.5% if you have 25% [Flask of Petrified Gold] equipped. 2x1.25=2.5". The same comment said set bonuses weren't working with it yet and were being fixed (2026-04) Bezawit · 2026-04-03. At 10% Fortune, a 1% proc becomes 1.1% Thirtyseven · 2026-03-20. - **On-use:** about 200 spell power for 20 seconds on a 120-second cooldown. That averages about 33 SP, slightly better than Talisman of Ephemeral Power's ~29 Bha! · 2026-04-05. - **Contested value:** melee rate it "a decent trinket with Thunderfury" Velanir · 2026-03-24 and theorycraft pairs it with HoJ, the Ironfoe set, the Wardens of Time cloak and the Timbermaw rings Kyrsie · 2026-04-01. For mages, one sim gave only about 1.5 SP per 1% Fortune even with every proc item equipped ("fortune is a dead stat") Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-26, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-26. Rule of thumb: it only pays off with 3-4 proc items Varnoc · 2026-04-01. Many proc items also got internal cooldowns in 1.18.1, which caps how much extra proc chance can add alyflex · 2026-03-20, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-20.

sections.heading: Where enchants come from
sections.markdown: ### Three sources Depending on the slot, an enchant comes from Jesse Potter · 2026-04-14: 1. **Enchanting.** Usually the buyer brings the mats and the enchanter applies it biloen · 2026-01-16. 2. **Jewelcrafting (Gemology).** See [Professions](#/professions). 3. **NPC quest enchants:** Hyjal, the Karazhan church, the Dire Maul library and Burning Steppes. ### Specific enchants | Enchant | Source | Notes | |---|---|---| | Shoulders: Sigil of Quickness (+2% haste) | Hyjal quest from an NPC in one of the houses in Nordanaar (the Hyjal town, not the realm) 🎄⛄ Bapi⛄🎄 · 2026-03-25, Luden TA · 2026-03-13 | Costs 5 Bright Dream Shards heligaknut · 2025-11-11, plus a Fading Dream Shard Destroses · 2025-11-11. About 20-25g at AH prices heligaknut · 2025-11-11, Rustam · 2026-04-05. Hyjal also offers +2% vampirism shoulders Rocnoir · 2026-04-11. The usual melee pick until the Sapphiron shoulder enchant Kyrsie · 2025-10-28 | | Bracer +12 spell power | Gelkis Centaur reputation (Desolace) Cleric · 2026-03-16 | Farm route: kill Magram to honored, do quests, then repeat the Magram bracer turn-in Hazelrah · 2025-10-07 | | Helm / legs (Zul'Gurub) | Bring the idol plus a voodoo doll to the NPC inside ZG Grey · 2026-02-15 | See [Zul'Gurub](#/instances/zulgurub) | Before Ambershire's later phases, Hyjal and the Argent Dawn were the only shoulder enchant sources there (2025-10) Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2025-10-28. ### "Spell is not ready" on fresh loot - **You can't enchant or imbue gear that just dropped.** Windfury, poisons and enchants fail with "Spell is not ready", because of the raid-loot trade timer. **Relog** to fix it, or wait about 10 minutes Gustafssonz · 2026-01-09, Not Normal · 2026-01-09, Not Normal · 2026-01-09, otep1616 · 2026-02-27.

sections.heading: Server rules, economy and realms
sections.markdown: ### Rules players quote - **Boosting for pay is banned.** The quoted rule: boosting is "paid or tipped runs where a notably higher leveled character will complete a dungeon for lower leveled character(s)". You may sell tanking, healing or damage in dungeons "within their own level bracket, with level 60s considered their own bracket" Danatious · 2026-03-02, Danatious · 2026-03-02. - **Rare spawns:** you can camp and sell BoE drops, but not BoP Modwolf · 2026-03-02. - **Boss loot:** the rules forbid selling boss loot publicly Elmgren · 2026-01-12. - World buffs are disabled in raids Elmgren · 2026-01-12. ### Epic riding cost - 900g for training plus 100g for the mount. Honored with the relevant faction gives 10% off, exalted another 10%, and PvP rank 3 another 10%, but the total discount is capped at **20%** Sylvaira · 2025-10-12. The paladin and warlock class mounts are cheaper Infertile · 2025-10-12, Key · 2025-10-12. Druids get epic riding through the Swift Travel Form questline (see [Druid leveling](#/class/druid/leveling)). ### Realm differences | Realm | Type | Faction rules | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | **Nordanaar** | The original PvE server, with the largest population Destroses · 2025-08-27, Destroses · 2025-07-12 | Cross-faction raids Mithreon · 2025-11-02 | All content, including Karazhan 40 Cysthen · 2025-10-15. Prices are inflated Excinerus · 2025-11-17 | | **Ambershire** | Fresh server, launched 2025-08; it drew players looking for a fresh start Destroses · 2025-08-27, Ravenhost · 2026-01-06 | Cross-faction, so Alliance get Windfury Breaddy · 2025-09-14 | Moves through content phases, so each tier gets time as current content Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-03-03. In 2026-01 it had Kara10, ZG and MC/Onyxia, with BWL next Exhausted_Vagrant · 2026-01-07, Beta · 2026-01-11. Some enchants, such as +15 Agility gloves, weren't available yet (2025-10) Cysthen · 2025-10-15 | | **Tel'Abim** | PvP server with a small population Kokuyo · 2025-09-13, Weirdthing · 2026-01-30 | "Nothing is shared between factions"; raids aren't cross-faction Sofie · 2026-03-28, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-10 | Horde have no Blessing of Salvation Not Normal · 2025-11-21, and Alliance have no Windfury, which hurts Ret paladins (see [Retribution](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps)) |

sections.heading: Stealth detection
sections.markdown: *Applies to rogues and to druids in Cat Form (Prowl).* - **Some mobs have boosted stealth detection,** for example the dogs in BRD and the Mind Flayers in AQ40. To check, step in and out of stealth: a mob with boosted detection spots you much farther away in stealth than out of it Scruff · 2026-02-06. See [Blackrock Depths](#/instances/blackrock-depths) and [AQ40](#/instances/ahnqiraj-temple). - **Custom zones are erratic.** Gilneas elites around level 45 sometimes break your stealth from about 1 m away, yet other times you can run past them riku · 2026-02-06, Scruff · 2026-02-06. See [Gilneas City](#/instances/gilneas-city). - **+Stealth gear helps in PvP, not much in PvE.** One rogue added up the sources at 8.4 levels (Camouflage +1, Darkmantle +1.4, cloak +1, cloak enchant +1, two rings +2, two trinkets +2), but mobs "notice" you inconsistently even at the same spot, and it doesn't help against True Sight Epickalen · 2025-12-05. Another rogue saw no difference in PvE, and "for undead in strat it seems to make no difference at all" Blindtongue · 2025-11-08, Blindtongue · 2025-11-08. See [Rogue leveling](#/class/rogue/leveling).

sections.heading: Training dummies
sections.markdown: Dummy numbers don't match raid numbers: - **Heroic dummies got spell-school resistances in 1.18.1,** so spell damage and ghost procs hit them for less than before Agnesia · 2026-03-21, Agnesia · 2026-03-21. - **Some minions never attack dummies:** Gnomish Battle Chicken, dragonlings, the K40 belt wolves and bomb-sigil bombs all work on real mobs but not on dummies dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-24, Beldrin · 2026-02-24. The "of the Lost" set's ghosts don't proc the bomb sigil dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-24. - **The dummy has about 4,000 armor,** more than a well-debuffed raid boss, which undersells physical attacks against spell damage Mithreon · 2025-11-18, Mithreon · 2025-11-16. - **No incoming damage means no rage from being hit,** so dual-wield warriors play differently than on a boss Dodging · 2025-10-21. - The guide's SoC vs SoR verdict leans on dummy tests, so read it with these caveats: [Retribution](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps), [Paladin sources](#/class/paladin/sources).
